series.title: Eyes of Fire
series.description: A dark science-fiction, historical-fantasy and psychological suspense saga built around secret experiments, a fracture in time, and the legend of a woman with burning eyes.
series.lore: Beneath Area 51, a secret experiment reaches beyond the limits of science. When the experiment tears time open, Victoria Stevens is thrown into 1400s Italy — altered, masked, and feared as the Woman with the Eyes of Fire. The fracture is not simply a doorway through history; it may be rewriting history itself.
series.world: Science gives way to impossible history. A woman who was treated as an experiment becomes a figure feared, remembered, and perhaps destined to change the past.

books.title: The Woman Of Fire
books.subtitle: What’s Left in Me?
books.synopsis: I often wonder what changed me more... the experiments, or the betrayal of the people I once called family. Sold to a secret facility beneath Area 51, I was sealed, rewritten, and broken. They believed they could erase who I was. They were wrong. When their final experiment tears time open, I awaken in 1400 — masked, altered, and feared as The Woman with the Eyes of Fire. Now history is mine to rewrite.
books.excerpt:
The People I Left

The people I left behind were never the people I thought they were.

I grew up believing that the first hands to hold me would be the last hands to let me fall. They told me they would protect me with their lives. I believed them.

Until they sold me.

They gave me to people who saw me not as a daughter, not as a human being, but as something they could cut open, alter, and rebuild. Inside a place hidden from the world, they took my voice, rewrote my body, and slowly erased the girl I used to be.

I remember the pain.

I remember the silence.

And most of all, I remember wondering why the people who promised to protect me were the ones who handed me over.

I was twenty-one when they took me.

I don't know how old I was when I stopped being the girl they sold.

But somewhere between the experiments, the blood, and the endless darkness, something inside me refused to disappear.

My name is Victoria Stevens.

And this is the story of what they made me become.

blocks.title: A legend split by time.
blocks.subtitle: Science. Betrayal. 1400.
blocks.text: A secret experiment reaches beyond the limits of science and opens a path into a world that was never meant to be touched.

blocks.title: Where the story begins
blocks.text:
Beneath Area 51, an experiment pushes past the boundary between what is known and what should remain impossible. Time fractures. A life is torn out of its era.

What follows is not simply survival. It is transformation — and the beginning of a legend.
Some legends are born in history. Others are thrown into it.
